/**
 * Ingredient Analysis API Client
 * 对接 /ingredients/* 端点（axios baseURL 已含 /api/v1，路径不带前缀）
 */
import api from './client'

export interface IngredientItem {
  name: string
  additive?: string
}

export interface AnalyzeRequest {
  ingredient_text: string
  ingredients?: IngredientItem[]
  nutrition?: Record<string, number>
  serving_size?: string
}

export interface AdditiveInfo {
  eCode: string
  name: string
  function: string
  risk: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'
  maxUsage?: string
  carcinogen?: boolean
  allergen?: boolean
  phenylketonuria?: boolean
}

export interface AnalysisResult {
  timestamp: string
  ingredientText: string
  ingredients: string[]
  nutriScore: number
  nutriGrade: { grade: string; color: string; label: string }
  novaResult: { group: number; label: string; description: string }
  additives: AdditiveInfo[]
  allergens: Array<{ name: string; level: string }>
  herbalIngredients: Array<{ name: string; tcmProperty: string }>
  nutritionTable: Array<{ nutrient: string; value: number; unit: string }>
  suggestions: Array<{ type: string; message: string }>
  overallScore: number
  overallGrade: { grade: string; color: string; label: string }
  riskLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'
  riskMessages: string[]
  servingSize: string
}

export interface FoodHomologyItem {
  name: string
  property: string
  category: string
  effect: string
}

export const ingredientApi = {
  analyze: (data: AnalyzeRequest) => api.post<AnalysisResult>('/ingredients/analyze', data),

  batchAnalyze: (data: { items: AnalyzeRequest[] }) =>
    api.post<Array<AnalysisResult>>('/ingredients/batch-analyze', data),

  getAdditives: () =>
    api.get<{ success: boolean; data: AdditiveInfo[]; total: number }>('/ingredients/additives'),

  getFoodHomology: () =>
    api.get<{ success: boolean; data: FoodHomologyItem[]; total: number }>('/ingredients/food-homology'),

  getHealthScore: (score: number) =>
    api.get(`/ingredients/health-score/${score}`),

  getIngredients: (params?: { page?: number; page_size?: number; search?: string }) =>
    api.get<{ success: boolean; data: { items: any[]; total: number } }>(
      '/ingredients',
      { params },
    ),
}

source:
/**
 * ChatStateContext - AI 对话状态上下文 (ADR-029 P1-1)
 *
 * 将所有 ChatTab 的状态和方法提取到 Context 中，
 * 使 ChatTab 组件成为纯布局组件。
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @created 2026-09-21
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext } from 'react'
import type { HistorySession } from './components/pro'
import type { ChatMessage } from './types'
import type { ScenarioMode } from './services/scenarioSwitcher'
import type { BackendThinkingStep } from './hooks/useThinkingProcessV3'

export interface ChatState {
  // ===== 消息状态 =====
  messages: ChatMessage[]
  input: string
  setInput: (value: string) => void
  isStreaming: boolean
  setIsStreaming: (streaming: boolean) => void
  chatError: Error | null
  setChatError: (e: Error | null) => void
  clearMessages: () => void
  addMessage: (message: ChatMessage) => void
  updateMessage: (id: string, updates: Partial<ChatMessage>) => void
  retryLastMessage: () => Promise<void>
  clearError: () => void
  isPaused: boolean
  pauseStreaming: () => void
  resumeStreaming: () => void
  editMessage: (id: string, newContent: string) => void
  retractMessage: (id: string) => void
  setActiveSessionId: (id: string | null) => void
  checkCompaction: () => Promise<void>

  // ===== 会话状态 =====
  historySessions: HistorySession[]
  setHistorySessions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<HistorySession[]>>
  activeSessionId: string | null
  setActiveSessionIdCtx: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | null>>
  historyVisible: boolean
  setHistoryVisible: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>

  // ===== UI 状态 =====
  isDetailModalOpen: boolean
  selectedForDetail: unknown
  showFormulaList: boolean
  searchQuery: string
  highlightedMessageId: string | null
  attachments: Array<{ id: string; file: File; previewUrl: string }>
  detailsCall: { id: string; name: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; result?: string; status: string; durationMs?: number } | null
  detailsOpen: boolean
  showKBPanel: boolean

  // ===== 引擎状态 =====
  llmAvailable: boolean
  llmModel: string
  scenarioMode: ScenarioMode
  assistantCount: number
  elapsedSeconds: number

  // ===== 配方状态 =====
  formulaCount: number
  expandedIds: Set<string>
  selectedIds: Set<string>
  formulas: unknown[]

  // ===== 报告状态 =====
  showReportModal: boolean
  /** 关闭报告弹窗并清理报告数据（实现为 useReportGenerator.clearReport） */
  setShowReportModal: (show: boolean) => void
  reportData: unknown
  isGeneratingReport: boolean

  // ===== 操作方法 =====
  handleSendMessage: (content: string) => Promise<void>
  handleNewSession: () => void
  handleSelectSession: (id: string) => void
  handleDeleteSession: (id: string) => void
  handleRenameSession: (id: string, title: string) => void
  handleClearChat: () => void
  handleRetry: () => Promise<void>
  handleSend: (content?: string) => Promise<void>
  handleForkMessage: (messageId: string) => Promise<void>
  handleAddAttachment: (file: File) => void
  handleRemoveAttachment: (id: string) => void
  toggleHistory: () => void
  syncSessionsFromServer: () => Promise<void>
  /** 生成配方报告（客户端生成，见 useReportGenerator）。formulaId 为空则汇总全部配方。 */
  handleGenerateReport: (formulaId?: string) => Promise<void>
}

export const ChatStateContext = createContext<ChatState | null>(null)

export function useChatState(): ChatState {
  const context = useContext(ChatStateContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useChatState must be used within ChatStateProvider')
  }
  return context
}

/** 供组件直接使用的便捷 Hook */
export function useChatContext(): ChatState {
  return useChatState()
}

/**
 * GenerateTab 配置常量
 *
 * @description 统一管理 GenerateTab 相关的所有配置常量
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { STORAGE, API } from '@/constants/businessRules'

// 药味角色常量
export const HERB_ROLES = ['君药', '臣药', '佐药', '使药'] as const
export type HerbRole = typeof HERB_ROLES[number]

// 输入模式类型
export type InputMode = 'effects' | 'manual'

// 视图模式类型
export type ViewMode = 'card' | 'compare'

// 生成器类型
export type GeneratorType = 'rule_engine' | 'ga' | 'llm' | 'neural_network'

// 配方分类类型
export type FormulaCategory =
  | 'IMMUNITY'
  | 'ANTI_FATIGUE'
  | 'DIGESTION'
  | 'SLEEP'
  | 'BEAUTY'
  | 'CARDIOVASCULAR'
  | 'BONE_JOINT'
  | 'VISION'
  | 'RESPIRATORY'
  | 'METABOLISM'

// 存储键配置
export const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  selectedEffects: 'rmfood:generate:selectedEffects',
  useLlm: 'rmfood:generate:useLlm',
  advancedMode: 'rmfood:generate:advancedMode',
  viewMode: 'rmfood:generate:viewMode',
} as const

// 验证配置
export const VALIDATION = {
  maxEffectSelection: 6,
  maxFormulaVersions: 100,
  maxFormulaNameLength: 100,
  maxDosageValue: 999999,
} as const

// 超时配置
export const TIMEOUTS = {
  saveSuccessDisplay: 3000,
  generation: 30000,
  analysis: 15000,
  save: 5000,
} as const

// 默认值配置
export const DEFAULTS = {
  viewMode: 'card' as ViewMode,
  useLlm: false,
  advancedMode: false,
  maxCandidates: 20,
  tasteScore: 80,
  stabilityScore: 75,
  safetyScore: 90,
  costScore: 70,
  dosageRange: '10-20g',
  unknownFormula: '未知配方',
  unknownIngredient: '未知药材',
  categoryCustom: '自定义',
  placeholderTexts: {
    unknownFormula: '未知配方',
    unknownIngredient: '未知药材',
    generationPreparing: '准备中...',
    generationParsing: '解析配方...',
    generationProcessing: '智能生成...',
    generationOptimizing: '优化配方...',
    generationValidating: '验证配方...',
    generationErrorTitle: '生成失败',
    generationSuccessTitle: '生成成功',
    generationSuccessMessagePrefix: '已生成',
    generationSuccessMessageSuffix: '个配方',
    saveSuccessTitle: '保存成功',
    saveSuccessMessagePrefix: '成功保存',
    saveSuccessMessageSuffix: '',
    pageTitleGenerate: 'AI配方生成',
    pageSubtitleGenerate: '智能生成个性化配方方案',
    buttonAdvancedMode: '高级模式',
    buttonSimpleMode: '简单模式',
    buttonRegenerate: '重新生成',
    buttonStartGenerate: '生成配方',
    buttonAIGenerate: 'AI智能生成',
    buttonSelectEffects: '功效选择',
    buttonManualInput: '手动输入',
    labelInputMode: '输入模式',
    labelEnableAIEnhancement: 'AI增强',
    titleSelectEffects: '选择功效',
    badgePopular: '热门',
    resultCountPrefix: '共',
    resultCountSuffix: '个配方',
    badgeAIModel: 'AI模型',
    badgeNeuralNetwork: '神经网络',
    badgeRuleEngine: '规则引擎',
    resultSubtitle: '点击配方可查看详细信息',
    buttonCardView: '卡片',
    buttonCompareView: '对比',
    buttonOptimizationAdvice: '优化建议',
    buttonShareFormula: '分享配方',
    buttonExport: '导出',
    titleVersionHistory: '版本历史',
    versionCountPrefix: '共',
    versionCountSuffix: '个版本',
    versionRemarkPrefix: '基于',
    versionRemarkSuffix: '生成',
    prefixVersion: '版本',
    successLoadVersion: '版本加载成功',
    successRollbackVersion: '已回滚到',
    infoVersionCompare: '版本对比',
    loadingText: '加载中...',
    errorNoticeTitle: '错误提示',
    closeNoticeButton: '关闭',
    categoryCustom: '自定义',
  },
} as const

// 分类对应的功效列表
export const CATEGORY_EFFECTS: Record<FormulaCategory, readonly string[]> = {
  IMMUNITY: ['增强免疫力', '免疫调节', '提高抵抗力'],
  ANTI_FATIGUE: ['抗疲劳', '缓解疲劳', '提升精力'],
  DIGESTION: ['健脾养胃', '促进消化', '调理脾胃'],
  SLEEP: ['安神助眠', '改善睡眠', '安神定志'],
  BEAUTY: ['美容养颜', '延缓衰老', '美容护肤'],
  CARDIOVASCULAR: ['心血管健康', '调节血脂', '保护心血管'],
  BONE_JOINT: ['骨骼关节', '强健筋骨', '关节保健'],
  VISION: ['明目护眼', '保护视力', '缓解眼疲劳'],
  RESPIRATORY: ['呼吸系统', '润肺止咳', '清咽利喉'],
  METABOLISM: ['代谢调节', '控制体重', '调节代谢'],
} as const

// 配方分类列表（用于UI展示）
export const FORMULA_CATEGORY_LIST: {
  id: FormulaCategory
  label: string
  color: string
}[] = [
  { id: 'IMMUNITY', label: '免疫力', color: 'var(--color-primary-400)' },
  { id: 'ANTI_FATIGUE', label: '抗疲劳', color: '#D97706' },
  { id: 'DIGESTION', label: '消化', color: '#84cc16' },
  { id: 'SLEEP', label: '睡眠', color: 'var(--color-primary-500, #10b981)' },
  { id: 'BEAUTY', label: '美容', color: '#D946EF' },
  { id: 'CARDIOVASCULAR', label: '心血管', color: '#FF3B30' },
  { id: 'BONE_JOINT', label: '骨关节', color: 'var(--color-info-600)' },
  { id: 'VISION', label: '视力', color: 'var(--color-primary-500, #10b981)' },
  { id: 'RESPIRATORY', label: '呼吸', color: '#14b8a6' },
  { id: 'METABOLISM', label: '代谢', color: '#EA580C' },
] as const

// 配方分类配置（用于UI展示）
export const FORMULA_CATEGORIES: Record<
  FormulaCategory,
  { label: string; color: string }
> = FORMULA_CATEGORY_LIST.reduce(
  (acc, cat) => ({
    ...acc,
    [cat.id]: { label: cat.label, color: cat.color },
  }),
  {} as Record<FormulaCategory, { label: string; color: string }>,
)

// 获取分类对应的功效
export function getCategoryEffects(
  category: FormulaCategory | 'all',
): readonly string[] | null {
  if (category === 'all') return null
  return CATEGORY_EFFECTS[category]
}

// 统一配置导出
export const GENERATE_TAB_CONFIG = {
  storage: STORAGE_KEYS,
  validation: VALIDATION,
  timeouts: TIMEOUTS,
  defaults: DEFAULTS,
  herbRoles: HERB_ROLES,
  categoryEffects: CATEGORY_EFFECTS,
  formulaCategoryList: FORMULA_CATEGORY_LIST,
  formulaCategories: FORMULA_CATEGORIES,
} as const

// 向后兼容：保留原有的导出名称
export const PLACEHOLDER_TEXTS = {
  UNKNOWN_FORMULA: DEFAULTS.placeholderTexts.unknownFormula,
  UNKNOWN_INGREDIENT: DEFAULTS.placeholderTexts.unknownIngredient,
  GENERATION_ERROR_TITLE: DEFAULTS.placeholderTexts.generationErrorTitle,
  INPUT_EMPTY: '请输入配方名称',
} as const

export const DEFAULT_DOSAGE_RANGE = DEFAULTS.dosageRange

// 视图模式常量
export const VIEW_MODE = {
  CARD: 'card' as ViewMode,
  COMPARE: 'compare' as ViewMode,
} as const

// 输入模式常量
export const INPUT_MODE = {
  EFFECTS: 'effects' as InputMode,
  MANUAL: 'manual' as InputMode,
} as const

// 类型导出（HerbRole 已在第12行通过 `export type HerbRole = typeof HERB_ROLES[number]` 导出）

Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).

/**
 * ErrorBoundary - AI 模块专用错误边界
 *
 * 统一使用核心 errorBoundary.tsx 的全局错误处理系统。
 * GlobalErrorBoundary 和 ModuleErrorBoundary 已合并到 core/errorBoundary.tsx。
 */
export {
  ErrorBoundary,
  ErrorTrackingProvider,
  useErrorTracking,
  configureErrorHandler,
  reportError,
} from '@/core/errorBoundary'

// 别名导出以保持向后兼容
export { ErrorBoundary as GlobalErrorBoundary } from '@/core/errorBoundary'
export { ErrorBoundary as ModuleErrorBoundary } from '@/core/errorBoundary'

/** * BlockRegistry — 区块类型到渲染组件的注册表 * * 职责： * - 将 BlockType 映射到对应的 React 组件 * - 提供统一的渲染接口 * - 支持未知类型的优雅降级 */ import React from 'react' import type { BlockType, ContentBlock } from './types' import HeaderBlock from './blocks/HeaderBlock' import DataTableBlock from './blocks/DataTableBlock' import ChartBlock from './blocks/ChartBlock' import ListBlock from './blocks/ListBlock' import CalloutBlock from './blocks/CalloutBlock' import MetricsBlock from './blocks/MetricsBlock' import DividerBlock from './blocks/DividerBlock' import IngredientDetailBlock from './blocks/IngredientDetailBlock' import SynergyChartBlock from './blocks/SynergyChartBlock' import TimelineBlock from './blocks/TimelineBlock' type BlockComponent = React.ComponentType<{ data: any }> const REGISTRY: Record = { 'header': HeaderBlock, 'data-table': DataTableBlock, 'chart': ChartBlock, 'list': ListBlock, 'callout': CalloutBlock, 'metrics': MetricsBlock, 'divider': DividerBlock, 'ingredient-detail': IngredientDetailBlock, 'synergy-chart': SynergyChartBlock, 'timeline': TimelineBlock, } /** * 根据 block type 获取对应的渲染组件 */ export function getBlockComponent(type: BlockType): BlockComponent | null { return REGISTRY[type] || null } /** * 渲染单个区块 * 处理未知类型、组件缺失等情况 */ export function renderBlock(block: ContentBlock, index: number): React.ReactNode { const Component = getBlockComponent(block.type) if (!Component) { return (
不支持的区块类型: {block.type}
) } return } export default REGISTRY

/**
 * FormulaDesignEngine — 食品配方智能设计引擎 v1.0
 *
 * 基于专利级配方的多维度智能算法，实现：
 * 1. 君臣佐使配伍分析（中医理论数字化）
 * 2. 成分兼容性矩阵（协同/拮抗/十八反十九畏）
 * 3. 多维度评分系统（功效/安全/口感/稳定/成本）
 * 4. 多目标 Pareto 优化
 * 5. 智能配方生成与迭代优化
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @lastUpdated 2026-06-07
 */

/* ================================================================== */
/*  类型定义                                                            */
/* ================================================================== */

/** 成分角色（君臣佐使） */
export type IngredientRole = 'jun' | 'chen' | 'zuo' | 'shi'

/** 成分类别 */
export type IngredientCategory =
  | 'herb'           // 药食同源
  | 'peptide'        // 肽类
  | 'vitamin'        // 维生素
  | 'mineral'        // 矿物质
  | 'probiotic'      // 益生菌
  | 'fiber'          // 膳食纤维
  | 'protein'        // 蛋白质
  | 'lipid'          // 脂类
  | 'botanical'      // 植物提取物
  | 'other'          // 其他

/** 交互类型 */
export type InteractionType =
  | 'synergy'        // 协同增强
  | 'additive'       // 相加作用
  | 'antagonism'     // 拮抗作用
  | 'toxicity'       // 毒性增强
  | 'incompatibility'// 配伍禁忌

/** 维度评分 */
export type ScoreDimension =
  | 'efficacy'       // 功效
  | 'safety'         // 安全性
  | 'taste'          // 口感
  | 'stability'      // 稳定性
  | 'cost'           // 成本

/* ================================================================== */
/*  核心数据接口                                                        */
/* ================================================================== */

/** 成分档案 */
export interface IngredientProfile {
  id: string
  name: string
  latinName?: string
  category: IngredientCategory
  roles: IngredientRole[]
  properties: {
    nature?: 'cold' | 'cool' | 'neutral' | 'warm' | 'hot'  // 四气
    flavor?: string[]                                        // 五味
    meridians?: string[]                                     // 归经
  }
  /** 推荐用量范围 (g) */
  dosageRange: [number, number]
  /** 安全阈值 (最大日用量 g) */
  safetyLimit: number
  /** 功效向量 [功效维度1,...] 0-1 */
  efficacyVector: Record<string, number>
  /** 成本系数 0-1 (低=便宜) */
  costFactor: number
  /** 口感评分 0-1 */
  tasteScore: number
  /** 稳定性评分 0-1 */
  stabilityScore: number
  /** 参考文献 */
  references: string[]
}

/** 成分间交互 */
export interface IngredientInteraction {
  ingredientA: string
  ingredientB: string
  type: InteractionType
  /** 交互强度 0-1 */
  strength: number
  description: string
  mechanism?: string
}

/** 配方候选 */
export interface FormulaCandidate {
  id: string
  name: string
  ingredients: Array<{
    profile: IngredientProfile
    dosage: number       // 克
    role: IngredientRole
    rationale: string    // 配伍理由
  }>
  scores: Record<ScoreDimension, number>
  overallScore: number
  compatibilityMatrix: Array<{
    pair: [string, string]
    interaction: InteractionType
    score: number
    description: string
  }>
  optimizationHistory?: Array<{
    iteration: number
    scores: Record<ScoreDimension, number>
    changes: string
  }>
}

/** 配方设计需求 */
export interface FormulaDesignRequest {
  targetEffects: string[]
  constraints?: {
    maxIngredients?: number
    maxCost?: number
    dietaryRestrictions?: string[]
    avoidIngredients?: string[]
    preferredCategories?: IngredientCategory[]
  }
  userProfile?: {
    age?: number
    healthConditions?: string[]
    allergies?: string[]
    goals?: string[]
  }
}

/** 优化目标权重 */
export interface OptimizationWeights {
  efficacy: number
  safety: number
  taste: number
  stability: number
  cost: number
}

/* ================================================================== */
/*  核心算法引擎                                                        */
/* ================================================================== */

export class FormulaDesignEngine {
  private ingredients: Map<string, IngredientProfile>
  private interactions: IngredientInteraction[]
  private interactionCache: Map<string, IngredientInteraction | null>

  constructor() {
    this.ingredients = new Map(Object.entries(INGREDIENT_DATABASE))
    this.interactions = INTERACTION_KNOWLEDGE
    this.interactionCache = new Map()
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  1. 成分查询                                                      */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /** 查询所有可用成分 */
  getAllIngredients(): IngredientProfile[] {
    return Array.from(this.ingredients.values())
  }

  /** 按功效查询成分 */
  findIngredientsByEffect(effect: string): IngredientProfile[] {
    const effectLower = effect.toLowerCase()
    const candidates: IngredientProfile[] = []

    for (const ingredient of this.ingredients.values()) {
      const matchesEffect = Object.entries(ingredient.efficacyVector)
        .some(([key, val]) => val > 0.5 && key.includes(effectLower))

      const matchesLabel = EFFICACY_DIMENSIONS[effectLower]
        ? EFFICACY_DIMENSIONS[effectLower].some(label =>
            effect.includes(label) || label.includes(effect)
          )
        : false

      if (matchesEffect || matchesLabel) {
        candidates.push(ingredient)
      }
    }

    // 按功效值排序
    return candidates.sort((a, b) => {
      const aScore = Object.entries(a.efficacyVector)
        .filter(([k]) => k.includes(effectLower))
        .reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0)
      const bScore = Object.entries(b.efficacyVector)
        .filter(([k]) => k.includes(effectLower))
        .reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0)
      return bScore - aScore
    })
  }

  /** 按关键词多维度搜索成分 */
  searchIngredients(query: string): IngredientProfile[] {
    const q = query.toLowerCase()
    return this.getAllIngredients().filter(ing =>
      ing.name.includes(q) ||
      ing.latinName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      ing.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      Object.keys(ing.efficacyVector).some(k => k.includes(q))
    )
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  2. 配伍分析                                                      */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /** 查询两个成分之间的交互 */
  getInteraction(ingA: string, ingB: string): IngredientInteraction | null {
    const key = [ingA, ingB].sort().join('::')
    if (this.interactionCache.has(key)) return this.interactionCache.get(key)!

    const interaction = this.interactions.find(
      i => (i.ingredientA === ingA && i.ingredientB === ingB) ||
           (i.ingredientA === ingB && i.ingredientB === ingA)
    ) || null

    this.interactionCache.set(key, interaction)
    return interaction
  }

  /** 分析一组成分的完整兼容性矩阵 */
  analyzeCompatibility(ingredientIds: string[]): FormulaCandidate['compatibilityMatrix'] {
    const matrix: FormulaCandidate['compatibilityMatrix'] = []

    for (let i = 0; i < ingredientIds.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < ingredientIds.length; j++) {
        const a = ingredientIds[i]
        const b = ingredientIds[j]
        const interaction = this.getInteraction(a, b)

        if (interaction) {
          matrix.push({
            pair: [a, b],
            interaction: interaction.type,
            score: interaction.type === 'synergy' ? interaction.strength
                 : interaction.type === 'additive' ? interaction.strength * 0.6
                 : interaction.type === 'antagonism' ? -interaction.strength
                 : -interaction.strength * 2,
            description: interaction.description,
          })
        } else {
          // 没有已知交互视为中性
          const aProf = this.ingredients.get(a)
          const bProf = this.ingredients.get(b)
          const neutralScore = (aProf && bProf)
            ? this.calculateTacitCompatibility(aProf, bProf)
            : 0

          matrix.push({
            pair: [a, b],
            interaction: neutralScore > 0 ? 'additive' : neutralScore < 0 ? 'antagonism' : 'additive',
            score: neutralScore,
            description: neutralScore > 0.15
              ? `${aProf!.name}与${bProf!.name}性质相合，可协同使用`
              : neutralScore < -0.1
                ? `${aProf!.name}与${bProf!.name}性质相异，谨慎配伍`
                : `${aProf!.name}与${bProf!.name}无已知相互作用，可安全配伍`,
          })
        }
      }
    }

    return matrix.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.score) - Math.abs(a.score))
  }

  /** 计算隐式兼容性（基于四气五味归经） */
  private calculateTacitCompatibility(a: IngredientProfile, b: IngredientProfile): number {
    let score = 0
    // 四气匹配
    if (a.properties.nature && b.properties.nature) {
      const natureOrder = ['cold', 'cool', 'neutral', 'warm', 'hot']
      const aIdx = natureOrder.indexOf(a.properties.nature)
      const bIdx = natureOrder.indexOf(b.properties.nature)
      const diff = Math.abs(aIdx - bIdx)
      score += diff <= 1 ? 0.15 : diff >= 3 ? -0.2 : 0
    }
    // 归经互补
    const commonMeridians = a.properties.meridians?.filter(m => b.properties.meridians?.includes(m)) ?? []
    score += commonMeridians.length * 0.08
    // 五味调和
    const commonFlavors = a.properties.flavor?.filter(f => b.properties.flavor?.includes(f)) ?? []
    score += commonFlavors.length * 0.05

    return Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, score))
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  3. 评分系统                                                      */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /** 多维度评分 */
  calculateScores(
    formula: FormulaCandidate['ingredients'],
    weights: OptimizationWeights = { efficacy: 0.3, safety: 0.25, taste: 0.15, stability: 0.15, cost: 0.15 }
  ): { scores: Record<ScoreDimension, number>; overallScore: number } {
    // 功效评分
    const efficacyScore = this.calculateEfficacyScore(formula)
    // 安全性评分
    const safetyScore = this.calculateSafetyScore(formula)
    // 口感评分
    const tasteScore = this.calculateTasteScore(formula)
    // 稳定性评分
    const stabilityScore = this.calculateStabilityScore(formula)
    // 成本评分
    const rawCost = formula.reduce((sum, ing) => sum + ing.profile.costFactor * (ing.dosage / 10), 0)
    const costScore = Math.max(0, 1 - rawCost / formula.length)

    const scores: Record<ScoreDimension, number> = {
      efficacy: Math.round(efficacyScore * 100) / 100,
      safety: Math.round(safetyScore * 100) / 100,
      taste: Math.round(tasteScore * 100) / 100,
      stability: Math.round(stabilityScore * 100) / 100,
      cost: Math.round(costScore * 100) / 100,
    }

    const overallScore =
      scores.efficacy * weights.efficacy +
      scores.safety * weights.safety +
      scores.taste * weights.taste +
      scores.stability * weights.stability +
      scores.cost * weights.cost

    return { scores, overallScore: Math.round(overallScore * 100) / 100 }
  }

  private calculateEfficacyScore(ingredients: FormulaCandidate['ingredients']): number {
    if (ingredients.length === 0) return 0
    const avgEfficacy = ingredients.reduce((sum, ing) => {
      const vals = Object.values(ing.profile.efficacyVector)
      return sum + (vals.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / vals.length)
    }, 0) / ingredients.length

    // 君药权重加成
    const junIngredients = ingredients.filter(i => i.role === 'jun')
    const junBonus = junIngredients.length > 0 ? 0.1 : 0

    return Math.min(1, avgEfficacy + junBonus)
  }

  private calculateSafetyScore(ingredients: FormulaCandidate['ingredients']): number {
    let score = 1
    for (const ing of ingredients) {
      const usageRatio = ing.dosage / ing.profile.safetyLimit
      if (usageRatio > 0.8) score -= 0.2
      else if (usageRatio > 0.6) score -= 0.1
      // 检查配伍禁忌
      for (const other of ingredients) {
        if (other.profile.id === ing.profile.id) continue
        const interaction = this.getInteraction(ing.profile.id, other.profile.id)
        if (interaction?.type === 'toxicity' || interaction?.type === 'incompatibility') {
          score -= 0.3
        }
      }
    }
    return Math.max(0.1, score)
  }

  private calculateTasteScore(ingredients: FormulaCandidate['ingredients']): number {
    if (ingredients.length === 0) return 0.5
    const avg = ingredients.reduce((s, i) => s + i.profile.tasteScore, 0) / ingredients.length
    // 苦味惩罚
    const bitterIngredients = ingredients.filter(i =>
      i.profile.properties.flavor?.includes('苦')
    )
    const bitterPenalty = bitterIngredients.length > 1 ? 0.1 * bitterIngredients.length : 0
    return Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, avg - bitterPenalty))
  }

  private calculateStabilityScore(ingredients: FormulaCandidate['ingredients']): number {
    if (ingredients.length === 0) return 0.5
    return ingredients.reduce((s, i) => s + i.profile.stabilityScore, 0) / ingredients.length
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  4. 角色分配算法 — 基于中医君臣佐使理论                            */
  /* ================================================================ */

  assignRoles(ingredientIds: string[], targetEffects: string[]): Map<string, IngredientRole> {
    const roles = new Map<string, IngredientRole>()
    if (ingredientIds.length === 0) return roles

    const profiles = ingredientIds.map(id => this.ingredients.get(id)).filter(Boolean) as IngredientProfile[]

    // 匹配主功效最强的成分 → 君药
    const effectRelevance = profiles.map(p => ({
      id: p.id,
      relevance: Object.entries(p.efficacyVector)
        .filter(([key]) => targetEffects.some(te => key.includes(te) || te.includes(key)))
        .reduce((score, [, val]) => score + val, 0),
    }))

    effectRelevance.sort((a, b) => b.relevance - a.relevance)

    if (effectRelevance.length > 0) {
      roles.set(effectRelevance[0].id, 'jun')
    }
    if (effectRelevance.length > 1) {
      roles.set(effectRelevance[1].id, 'chen')
    }
    // 剩余成分按角色匹配度分配
    for (let i = 2; i < effectRelevance.length; i++) {
      const id = effectRelevance[i].id
      const profile = this.ingredients.get(id)!
      // 如果成分是shi角色或者无毒调和类 → 使药
      if (profile.roles.includes('shi') || profile.id === 'licorice') {
        roles.set(id, 'shi')
      } else {
        roles.set(id, 'zuo')
      }
    }

    return roles
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  5. 配方生成算法                                                    */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /**
   * 根据需求智能生成配方
   * 使用多目标优化策略
   */
  generateFormula(request: FormulaDesignRequest): FormulaCandidate {
    const { targetEffects, constraints } = request
    const maxIngredients = constraints?.maxIngredients ?? 6

    // 5.1 根据目标功效筛选候选成分
    const candidates = new Set<string>()
    for (const effect of targetEffects) {
      const matches = this.findIngredientsByEffect(effect)
      matches.forEach(m => candidates.add(m.id))
    }

    // 5.2 排除禁忌成分
    if (constraints?.avoidIngredients) {
      constraints.avoidIngredients.forEach(id => candidates.delete(id))
    }

    let selectedIds = Array.from(candidates)

    // 5.3 智能筛选：如果候选太多，优先选择功效向量覆盖最广的
    if (selectedIds.length > maxIngredients * 2) {
      const scored = selectedIds.map(id => {
        const prof = this.ingredients.get(id)!
        const effectCoverage = targetEffects.reduce((score, effect) => {
          const matches = Object.entries(prof.efficacyVector)
            .filter(([key]) => key.includes(effect) || effect.includes(key))
          return score + matches.reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0)
        }, 0)
        return { id, score: effectCoverage }
      })
      scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      selectedIds = scored.slice(0, maxIngredients * 2).map(s => s.id)
    }

    // 5.4 智能组合优化：迭代寻找最佳组合
    const selectedProfiles = selectedIds.map(id => this.ingredients.get(id)!).filter(Boolean)
    let bestScore = -Infinity

    // 简化组合搜索（实际应用中应使用遗传算法/模拟退火）
    const combinationSize = Math.min(maxIngredients, selectedProfiles.length)

    // 贪心选择：逐个添加最优成分
    const chosen: string[] = []
    const remaining = new Set(selectedIds)

    // 第一个选功效覆盖最广的
    while (chosen.length < combinationSize && remaining.size > 0) {
      let best = ''
      let bestGain = -Infinity

      for (const candidateId of remaining) {
        const testSet = [...chosen, candidateId]
        const testCombination = testSet.map(id => ({
          profile: this.ingredients.get(id)!,
          dosage: this.suggestDosage(this.ingredients.get(id)!, 'chen'),
          role: 'chen' as IngredientRole,
          rationale: '',
        }))
        const { overallScore } = this.calculateScores(testCombination)
        // 加上兼容性评分
        const compatMatrix = this.analyzeCompatibility(testSet)
        const compatScore = compatMatrix.reduce((s, item) => s + item.score, 0) / Math.max(1, compatMatrix.length)
        const gain = overallScore * 0.7 + compatScore * 0.3

        if (gain > bestGain) {
          bestGain = gain
          best = candidateId
        }
      }

      if (best) {
        chosen.push(best)
        remaining.delete(best)
        // 如果最佳分数远低于组合，停止添加
        if (bestGain < bestScore - 0.3 && chosen.length >= 3) break
        bestScore = bestGain
      } else {
        break
      }
    }

    // 5.5 角色分配
    const roleMap = this.assignRoles(chosen, targetEffects)

    // 5.6 用量建议
    const ingredients = chosen.map(id => {
      const profile = this.ingredients.get(id)!
      const role = roleMap.get(id) || 'zuo'
      const dosage = this.suggestDosage(profile, role)
      return {
        profile,
        dosage,
        role,
        rationale: this.generateRationale(profile, role, targetEffects),
      }
    })

    // 5.7 兼容性分析
    const compatibilityMatrix = this.analyzeCompatibility(chosen)

    // 5.8 评分
    const { scores, overallScore } = this.calculateScores(ingredients)

    // 5.9 配方命名
    const name = this.generateFormulaName(ingredients, targetEffects)

    return {
      id: `formula_${Date.now()}`,
      name,
      ingredients,
      scores,
      overallScore,
      compatibilityMatrix,
    }
  }

  /** 智能用量建议 */
  private suggestDosage(profile: IngredientProfile, role: IngredientRole): number {
    const [min, max] = profile.dosageRange
    const range = max - min

    switch (role) {
      case 'jun':  return Math.round((min + range * 0.75) * 10) / 10
      case 'chen': return Math.round((min + range * 0.5) * 10) / 10
      case 'zuo':  return Math.round((min + range * 0.35) * 10) / 10
      case 'shi':  return Math.round((min + range * 0.25) * 10) / 10
    }
  }

  /** 智能配伍理由生成 */
  private generateRationale(profile: IngredientProfile, role: IngredientRole, effects: string[]): string {
    const roleLabels: Record<IngredientRole, string> = {
      jun: '君药 — 针对主功效的核心成分',
      chen: '臣药 — 辅助君药增强功效',
      zuo: '佐药 — 制约毒性/辅助治疗',
      shi: '使药 — 调和诸药/引经',
    }

    const effectDesc = Object.entries(profile.efficacyVector)
      .filter(([key]) => effects.some(e => key.includes(e)))
      .map(([key, val]) => `${key}(${Math.round(val * 100)}%)`)
      .join(', ')

    return `${roleLabels[role]}。${profile.name}功效特性：${effectDesc || '多维度健康支持'}。`
  }

  /** 智能配方命名 */
  private generateFormulaName(ingredients: FormulaCandidate['ingredients'], effects: string[]): string {
    const junIngredient = ingredients.find(i => i.role === 'jun')
    const chenIngredient = ingredients.find(i => i.role === 'chen')
    const effectLabel = effects.length > 0 ? effects[0] : '综合调理'

    const prefix = junIngredient ? junIngredient.profile.name : ''
    const suffix = chenIngredient ? chenIngredient.profile.name : ''

  if (prefix && suffix) {
      return `${prefix}${suffix}${effectLabel}配方`
    }
    return `${effectLabel}优化配方 v1`
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  6. 配方优化算法 — Pareto 多目标优化                               */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /**
   * 配方迭代优化
   * 通过调整用量和成分组合，寻找 Pareto 最优解
   */
  optimizeFormula(
    baseFormula: FormulaCandidate,
    iterations: number = 3
  ): FormulaCandidate[] {
    const paretoFront: FormulaCandidate[] = [baseFormula]

    for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
      const current = paretoFront[paretoFront.length - 1]

      // 生成变体：微调用量
      const variant1 = this.createDosageVariant(current, 0.9)
      const variant2 = this.createDosageVariant(current, 1.1)

      for (const variant of [variant1, variant2].filter(Boolean)) {
        if (variant) {
          // Pareto 支配检查
          const dominated = paretoFront.some(existing =>
            Object.keys(existing.scores).every(
              dim => existing.scores[dim as ScoreDimension] >= variant.scores[dim as ScoreDimension]
            ) &&
            Object.keys(existing.scores).some(
              dim => existing.scores[dim as ScoreDimension] > variant.scores[dim as ScoreDimension]
            )
          )
          if (!dominated) {
            variant.optimizationHistory = [
              ...(current.optimizationHistory || []),
              {
                iteration: i + 1,
                scores: { ...variant.scores },
                changes: `调整用量至 ${(i === 0 ? '90%' : '110%')}`,
              },
            ]
            paretoFront.push(variant)
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return paretoFront.sort((a, b) => b.overallScore - a.overallScore)
  }

  private createDosageVariant(
    base: FormulaCandidate,
    factor: number
  ): FormulaCandidate | null {
    const newIngredients = base.ingredients.map(ing => ({
      profile: ing.profile,
      dosage: Math.round(Math.min(ing.profile.safetyLimit, Math.max(
        ing.profile.dosageRange[0], ing.dosage * factor
      )) * 10) / 10,
      role: ing.role,
      rationale: ing.rationale,
    }))

    const { scores, overallScore } = this.calculateScores(newIngredients)
    const compatibilityMatrix = this.analyzeCompatibility(
      newIngredients.map(i => i.profile.id)
    )

    if (overallScore <= base.overallScore) return null

    return {
      ...base,
      id: `formula_opt_${Date.now()}`,
      ingredients: newIngredients,
      scores,
      overallScore,
      compatibilityMatrix,
    }
  }

  /* ================================================================ */
  /*  7. 结构化输出 — 转换为 Content Block 数据                         */
  /* ================================================================ */

  /**
   * 将配方结果转换为结构化内容块
   * 供 StructuredMessageRenderer 渲染
   */
  toStructuredBlocks(formula: FormulaCandidate) {
    const blocks: Array<{ type: string; data: any }> = []

    // 7.1 标题块
    blocks.push({
      type: 'header',
      data: {
        title: `🧪 ${formula.name}`,
        description: `综合评分 ${Math.round(formula.overallScore * 100)}分 | 由 FormulaDesignEngine v1.0 智能生成`,
        level: 1,
        metadata: [
          { label: '成分数', value: `${formula.ingredients.length} 味` },
          { label: '综合评分', value: `${Math.round(formula.overallScore * 100)}` },
          { label: '优化迭代', value: `${formula.optimizationHistory?.length || 1} 轮` },
        ],
      },
    })

    // 7.2 KPI 指标块
    blocks.push({
      type: 'metrics',
      data: {
        title: '多维评分',
        items: [
          { label: '功效', value: Math.round(formula.scores.efficacy * 100), unit: '分', trend: 'up', color: 'text-primary-700' },
          { label: '安全', value: Math.round(formula.scores.safety * 100), unit: '分', trend: 'up', color: 'text-primary-700' },
          { label: '口感', value: Math.round(formula.scores.taste * 100), unit: '分', trend: formula.scores.taste > 0.6 ? 'up' : 'stable', color: 'text-warning-600' },
          { label: '稳定', value: Math.round(formula.scores.stability * 100), unit: '分', trend: 'up', color: 'text-secondary-600' },
          { label: '成本', value: Math.round(formula.scores.cost * 100), unit: '分', trend: formula.scores.cost > 0.6 ? 'up' : 'down', color: 'text-accent-600' },
        ],
      },
    })

    // 7.3 成分表
    blocks.push({
      type: 'data-table',
      data: {
        title: '配方组成（君臣佐使）',
        columns: [
          { key: 'role', label: '角色', type: 'tag' },
          { key: 'name', label: '成分' },
          { key: 'dosage', label: '用量(g)', type: 'number', align: 'right' },
          { key: 'efficacy', label: '功效评分', type: 'percentage', align: 'center' },
          { key: 'rationale', label: '配伍理由' },
        ],
        rows: formula.ingredients.map(ing => ({
          role: this.getRoleLabel(ing.role),
          name: ing.profile.name,
          dosage: ing.dosage,
          efficacy: Object.values(ing.profile.efficacyVector).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / Math.max(1, Object.keys(ing.profile.efficacyVector).length),
          rationale: ing.rationale.split('。')[0],
        })),
        summary: `共 ${formula.ingredients.length} 味成分，遵循君臣佐使配伍原则`,
      },
    })

    // 7.4 兼容性分析列表
    const synergyCount = formula.compatibilityMatrix.filter(m => m.interaction === 'synergy').length
    const warningCount = formula.compatibilityMatrix.filter(m => m.interaction === 'antagonism' || m.interaction === 'toxicity').length

    blocks.push({
      type: 'list',
      data: {
        title: `配伍分析（${synergyCount}项协同 · ${warningCount}项注意）`,
        variant: 'analysis' as const,
        items: formula.compatibilityMatrix.slice(0, 8).map(item => {
          const getLabel = (id: string) => this.ingredients.get(id)?.name || id
          return {
            label: `${getLabel(item.pair[0])} + ${getLabel(item.pair[1])}`,
            description: item.description,
            status: item.interaction === 'synergy' ? 'positive'
                  : item.interaction === 'additive' ? 'info'
                  : 'negative',
          }
        }),
      },
    })

    // 7.5 优化历史
    if (formula.optimizationHistory && formula.optimizationHistory.length > 0) {
      blocks.push({
        type: 'data-table',
        data: {
          title: '优化迭代记录',
          columns: [
            { key: 'iteration', label: '轮次', type: 'number' },
            { key: 'efficacy', label: '功效', type: 'percentage', align: 'center' },
            { key: 'safety', label: '安全', type: 'percentage', align: 'center' },
            { key: 'taste', label: '口感', type: 'percentage', align: 'center' },
            { key: 'overall', label: '综合', type: 'percentage', align: 'center' },
            { key: 'changes', label: '调整' },
          ],
          rows: formula.optimizationHistory.map(h => ({
            iteration: h.iteration,
            efficacy: h.scores.efficacy,
            safety: h.scores.safety,
            taste: h.scores.taste,
            overall: (h.scores.efficacy + h.scores.safety + h.scores.taste + h.scores.stability + h.scores.cost) / 5,
            changes: h.changes,
          })),
        },
      })
    }

    // 7.6 总结 Callout
    blocks.push({
      type: 'callout',
      data: {
        variant: 'summary' as const,
        title: '配方设计说明',
        content: `本配方由 AI 智能设计引擎基于 ${formula.ingredients.map(i => i.profile.name).join('、')} 等${formula.ingredients.length}味成分优化组合而成。${formula.scores.safety >= 0.7 ? '安全性评估通过，' : '建议在专业指导下使用。'}${formula.scores.cost > 0.6 ? '成本控制合理。' : '成本偏高，可考虑替代原料。'}`,
        details: [
          '推荐用法：每日 1-2 次，温水冲服',
          '禁忌人群：孕妇、哺乳期妇女及儿童慎用',
          '储存条件：阴凉干燥处密封保存',
          `参考文献：${formula.ingredients.flatMap(i => i.profile.references).slice(0, 4).join('、')}`,
        ],
      },
    })

    return blocks
  }

  private getRoleLabel(role: IngredientRole): string {
    const labels: Record<IngredientRole, string> = {
      jun: '君药', chen: '臣药', zuo: '佐药', shi: '使药',
    }
    return labels[role]
  }
}

/**
 * 专业级智能建议引擎 V4.0 - Professional Intelligence Engine V4.0
 *
 * 核心升级特性：
 * 1. 知识图谱扩展至 120+ 术语（12个核心领域）
 * 2. NLP增强型混合意图识别模型（准确率目标 ≥95%）
 * 3. 三级缓存 + 智能预计算架构（响应时间 ≤80ms）
 * 4. 建议质量评估反馈闭环系统
 * 5. 插件化架构支持未来扩展
 */

// ============ 类型定义扩展 ============

export interface SystemLimitation {
  id: string
  category: 'knowledge_graph' | 'intent_classification' | 'caching' | 'performance' | 'scalability' | 'learning'
  severity: number // 1-10 (10最严重)
  description: string
  impact: {
    performanceLoss: number // % 性能损失
    coverageGap: number // % 覆盖率缺口
    userExperienceImpact: number // 1-10 用户体验影响
  }
  currentStatus: string
  targetStatus: string
  optimizationPriority: 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'
}

export interface OptimizationMetric {
  id: string
  name: string
  currentValue: number
  targetValue: number
  unit: string
  measurementMethod: string
  validationFrequency: 'realtime' | 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly'
}

export interface ImplementationPhase {
  phaseId: number
  name: string
  duration: string
  objectives: string[]
  deliverables: string[]
  successCriteria: string[]
  risks: { description: string; probability: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; mitigation: string }[]
  dependencies: number[]
}

// ============ 系统限制量化评估报告 ============

export const SYSTEM_LIMITATIONS_ANALYSIS: SystemLimitation[] = [
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-001',
    category: 'knowledge_graph',
    severity: 9,
    description: '知识图谱规模不足（当前30个术语 vs 目标120+），导致专业术语识别覆盖率仅约65%',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 25,
      coverageGap: 35,
      userExperienceImpact: 9,
    },
    currentStatus: '30个术语/10个领域',
    targetStatus: '120+个术语/12个领域',
    optimizationPriority: 'critical',
  },
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-002',
    category: 'intent_classification',
    severity: 8,
    description: '纯规则引擎意图分类准确率天花板约88%，无法处理歧义输入和复杂语义',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 15,
      coverageGap: 20,
      userExperienceImpact: 8,
    },
    currentStatus: '规则引擎(4个意图类别)',
    targetStatus: 'NLP增强型混合模型(12+意图类别, 准确率≥95%)',
    optimizationPriority: 'critical',
  },
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-003',
    category: 'caching',
    severity: 7,
    description: '单级内存缓存（200条/5分钟TTL）在高并发场景下命中率下降至60%以下',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 20,
      coverageGap: 15,
      userExperienceImpact: 7,
    },
    currentStatus: '单级LRU缓存(200条)',
    targetStatus: '三级缓存架构(L1内存+L2预计算+L3持久化, 命中率≥95%)',
    optimizationPriority: 'high',
  },
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-004',
    category: 'performance',
    severity: 6,
    description: '单例模式+同步处理导致并发请求排队，平均响应时间波动范围40-150ms',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 18,
      coverageGap: 10,
      userExperienceImpact: 6,
    },
    currentStatus: '单例同步处理(平均80ms)',
    targetStatus: '异步Worker池+请求队列(平均≤50ms, P99≤80ms)',
    optimizationPriority: 'high',
  },
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-005',
    category: 'learning',
    severity: 8,
    description: '缺乏实时学习能力，无法根据用户反馈持续优化建议质量和排序算法',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 22,
      coverageGap: 30,
      userExperienceImpact: 8,
    },
    currentStatus: '静态规则无学习',
    targetStatus: '反馈闭环系统(点击率学习+A/B测试+自动调优)',
    optimizationPriority: 'high',
  },
  {
    id: 'LIMIT-006',
    category: 'scalability',
    severity: 5,
    description: '单体架构难以水平扩展，新增领域或模板需要修改核心代码',
    impact: {
      performanceLoss: 12,
      coverageGap: 18,
      userExperienceImpact: 5,
    },
    currentStatus: '单体紧耦合架构',
    targetStatus: '插件化微内核架构(热插拔领域模块)',
    optimizationPriority: 'medium',
  },
]

// ============ 优化效果评估指标体系 ============

export const OPTIMIZATION_METRICS: OptimizationMetric[] = [
  {
    id: 'METRIC-001',
    name: '平均响应时间',
    currentValue: 80,
    targetValue: 50,
    unit: 'ms',
    measurementMethod: 'performance.now()端到端计时',
    validationFrequency: 'realtime',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-002',
    name: 'P99响应时间',
    currentValue: 150,
    targetValue: 80,
    unit: 'ms',
    measurementMethod: '百分位统计分析',
    validationFrequency: 'hourly',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-003',
    name: '专业术语识别覆盖率',
    currentValue: 65,
    targetValue: 95,
    unit: '%',
    measurementMethod: '标准测试集(1000样本)对比',
    validationFrequency: 'weekly',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-004',
    name: '意图分类准确率',
    currentValue: 88,
    targetValue: 95,
    unit: '%',
    measurementMethod: '多类别混淆矩阵分析',
    validationFrequency: 'weekly',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-005',
    name: '建议相关性评分',
    currentValue: 93,
    targetValue: 97,
    unit: '分(100分制)',
    measurementMethod: '专家评审团盲评(10人×100样本)',
    validationFrequency: 'monthly',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-006',
    name: '缓存命中率',
    currentValue: 72,
    targetValue: 95,
    unit: '%',
    measurementMethod: '缓存访问日志统计',
    validationFrequency: 'realtime',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-007',
    name: '用户采纳率',
    currentValue: 35,
    targetValue: 55,
    unit: '%',
    measurementMethod: '建议点击/展示比',
    validationFrequency: 'daily',
  },
  {
    id: 'METRIC-008',
    name: '内存占用',
    currentValue: 45,
    targetValue: 60,
    unit: 'MB',
    measurementMethod: 'performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize',
    validationFrequency: 'hourly',
  },
]

// ============ 阶段性实施计划 ============

export const IMPLEMENTATION_PHASES: ImplementationPhase[] = [
  {
    phaseId: 1,
    name: '基础架构升级与性能基准建立',
    duration: '第1-2周',
    objectives: [
      '建立完整的性能监控体系',
      '实现三级缓存架构原型',
      '扩展知识图谱至80个术语(8个核心领域)',
    ],
    deliverables: [
      '性能基准测试报告(V3基线数据)',
      '三级缓存模块代码',
      '扩展后的知识图谱V1',
    ],
    successCriteria: [
      '响应时间降低30%(80ms→56ms)',
      '缓存命中率提升至85%',
      '术语识别覆盖率提升至82%',
    ],
    risks: [
      { description: '缓存一致性难题', probability: 'medium', mitigation: '采用事件驱动失效机制' },
      { description: '知识图谱数据质量控制', probability: 'low', mitigation: '建立自动化校验流程' },
    ],
    dependencies: [],
  },

export interface PluginInterface {
  id: string
  version: string
  name: string
  domain: string
  capabilities: string[]
  initialize(): Promise<void>

}

  type: 'term_recognizer' | 'intent_classifier' | 'suggestion_generator' | 'quality_scorer' | 'cache_provider'

  plugin: PluginInterface
}

date.getTime()) / (1000 * 60)) if (diffInMinutes < 1) return '刚刚' if (diffInMinutes < 60) return `${diffInMinutes}分钟前` if (diffInMinutes < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diffInMinutes / 60)}小时前` return date.toLocaleDateString() } // 过滤事件 const filteredEvents = events.filter(event => { const matchesAction = filterAction === 'all' || event.action === filterAction const matchesUser = filterUser === 'all' || event.userId === filterUser const matchesSearch = searchTerm === '' || event.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || event.userName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || event.entityName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) return matchesAction && matchesUser && matchesSearch }) // 获取所有用户 const users = Array.from(new Set(events.map(event => event.userId))) const userMap = new Map(events.map(event => [event.userId, event.userName])) return (

import React from'react'
import * as LucideIcons from'lucide-react'

// 定义图标名称类型
export type IconName = keyof typeof LucideIcons

export type IconVariant ='primary' |'secondary' |'tertiary' |'success' |'warning' |'error' |'info' |'text' |'muted'

interface IconProps {
 name: IconName
 size?: number
 className?: string
 color?: string
 variant?: IconVariant
}

export const Icon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
 name,
 size = 24,
 className ='',
 color,
 variant,
}) => {
 const LucideIcon = (LucideIcons as unknown as Record<string, React.FC<import('lucide-react').LucideProps>>)[name]

 if (!LucideIcon || typeof LucideIcon !=='function') {
 return null
 }

 let iconColor: string | undefined = color

 if (!color && variant) {
 switch (variant) {
 case'primary':
 iconColor ='var(--color-primary)'
 break
 case'secondary':
 iconColor ='var(--color-secondary)'
 break
 case'tertiary':
 iconColor ='var(--color-tertiary)'
 break
 case'success':
 iconColor ='var(--color-success)'
 break
 case'warning':
 iconColor ='var(--color-warning)'
 break
 case'error':
 iconColor ='var(--color-error)'
 break
 case'info':
 iconColor ='var(--color-info)'
 break
 case'text':
 iconColor ='var(--text-primary)'
 break
 case'muted':
 iconColor ='var(--text-secondary)'
 break
 default:
 iconColor ='var(--text-primary)'
 }
 }

 return (
 <LucideIcon
 size={size}
 className={className}
 style={iconColor ? { color: iconColor } : undefined}
 aria-hidden="true"
 />
 )
}

// 导出所有 Lucide 图标，保持向后兼容
export * from'lucide-react'

import type { ComponentType } from 'react'
import React from 'react'

export type IconSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
export type IconVariant = 'default' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info'

export interface IconProps {
  size?: IconSize
  variant?: IconVariant
  className?: string
}

const SIZE_MAP: Record<IconSize, number> = {
  xs: 14,
  sm: 16,
  md: 20,
  lg: 24,
  xl: 32,
}

const VARIANT_CLASSES: Record<IconVariant, string> = {
  default: 'text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400',
  primary: 'text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-700',
  success: 'text-success-600 dark:text-success-600',
  warning: 'text-warning-600 dark:text-warning-700',
  danger: 'text-error-600 dark:text-error-600',
  info: 'text-secondary-600 dark:text-secondary-700',
}

export function StandardIcon({
  icon: IconComponent,
  size = 'md',
  variant = 'default',
  className = '',
}: IconProps & { icon: ComponentType<{ className?: string; size?: number }> }) {
  const sizeValue = SIZE_MAP[size]
  const variantClass = VARIANT_CLASSES[variant]

  return (
    <IconComponent
      size={sizeValue}
      className={`${variantClass} ${className}`.trim()}
    />
  )
}

Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).

Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).

Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).

Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.

Calling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. (https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect).

/** * 集成与API管理页面 — v5.0 仪表盘风格重构版 * * 设计改进： * - 顶部主色横幅替代标题行，与 Dashboard 风格统一 * - 横排药丸 Tab 导航，桌面自动显示，移动端 overflow-x-auto * - 宽卡片布局，去除紧凑限制，充分利用屏幕空间 * - 全页面间距宽松（space-y-6、card p-[var(--space-apple-lg)]、section gap-5） * - 使用 Button/Card 组件统一样式 * - 对接真实后端 /api/v1/integrations/api-keys */ import { useState } from 'react' import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next' import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' import { Plug, Webhook, Key, Plus, Copy, Trash2, ExternalLink, Slack, MessageCircle, Bell, RefreshCw, Check, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Info, } from 'lucide-react' import { Button, Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter, } from '@/components/ui' import { Badge } from '@/components/ui' import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/Toast' import { listAPIKeys, revokeAPIKey } from '@/api/integrations' import ApiKeyCreateDialog from '@/components/integrations/ApiKeyCreateDialog' interface APIKeyItem { id: string name: string prefix: string scopes: string[] lastUsed: string | null created: string } interface WebhookItem { id: string name: string url: string events: string[] successCount: number failureCount: number } const TABS: { id: 'api-keys' | 'webhooks' | 'third-party'; labelKey: string; icon: typeof Key }[] = [ { id: 'api-keys', labelKey: 'pages.integrations.tabApiKeys', icon: Key }, { id: 'webhooks', labelKey: 'pages.integrations.tabWebhooks', icon: Webhook }, { id: 'third-party', labelKey: 'pages.integrations.tabThirdParty', icon: Plug }, ] export default function IntegrationsPage() { const { t, i18n } = useTranslation() const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'api-keys' | 'webhooks' | 'third-party'>('api-keys') const { addToast } = useToast() const qc = useQueryClient() // ─── Fetch API keys from backend ────────────────────────────────── const { data: apiKeysData, isLoading: keysLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: ['integrations-api-keys'], queryFn: listAPIKeys, staleTime: 30_000, }) const deleteKeyMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: revokeAPIKey, onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['integrations-api-keys'] }) addToast({ type: 'success', message: t('pages.integrations.keyDeleted') }) }, }) // 创建密钥 Dialog（共享组件统一处理创建 + 一次性明文展示） const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false) const refreshApiKeys = () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['integrations-api-keys'] }) // Normalize backend data to UI model const apiKeys: APIKeyItem[] = (apiKeysData?.keys ?? []).map((k) => ({ id: k.id, name: k.name, prefix: k.key_prefix, scopes: k.scopes, lastUsed: k.last_used_at, created: k.created_at ? new Date(k.created_at).toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '—', })) const webhooks: WebhookItem[] = [ { id: '1', name: t('pages.integrations.webhookNames.formulaPublished'), url: 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00...', events: ['formula.published'], successCount: 156, failureCount: 2, }, { id: '2', name: t('pages.integrations.webhookNames.experimentCompleted'), url: 'https://api.example.com/webhook/experiment', events: ['experiment.completed'], successCount: 89, failureCount: 0, }, ] const renderApiKeyRow = (key: APIKeyItem) => (
{key.name} {t('pages.integrations.active')}
{key.prefix}
{t('pages.integrations.scopes', { scopes: key.scopes.join(', ') })} • {t('pages.integrations.created', { date: key.created })} {key.lastUsed && ( <> • {t('pages.integrations.lastUsed', { time: new Date(key.lastUsed).toLocaleString(i18n.language) })} )}
) const renderWebhookCard = (wh: WebhookItem) => { const rate = wh.successCount + wh.failureCount > 0 ? Math.round(wh.successCount / (wh.successCount + wh.failureCount) * 100) : 100 return (
{wh.name} {wh.url}
{rate}%
{wh.events.map(event => ( {event} ))}
{t('pages.integrations.success', { count: wh.successCount })} {t('pages.integrations.failed', { count: wh.failureCount })}
) } const renderThirdPartyCard = (service: { name: string; icon: typeof Slack; desc: string; color: string; connected: boolean }) => (
{service.name} {service.desc}
{service.connected && (
{t('pages.integrations.connected')}
)} ) return (
{/* 顶部横幅 */}

{t('pages.integrations.title')}

{t('pages.integrations.subtitle')}

{/* 横向药丸 Tab */}
{TABS.map(({ id, labelKey, icon: Icon }) => { const active = activeTab === id return ( ) })}
{/* API 密钥 */} {activeTab === 'api-keys' && (
{t('pages.integrations.apiKeysTitle')} {t('pages.integrations.apiKeysDesc')}
{apiKeys.map(renderApiKeyRow)}

{t('pages.integrations.keySecurityHint')}

)} {/* 创建密钥 Dialog（共享组件统一处理创建 + 一次性明文展示） */} {/* Webhook */} {activeTab === 'webhooks' && (
{t('pages.integrations.webhookConfig')} {t('pages.integrations.webhookDesc')}
{webhooks.map(renderWebhookCard)}
)} {/* 第三方集成 */} {activeTab === 'third-party' && (
{t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyTitle')} {t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyDesc')}
{[ { name: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyNames.slack'), icon: Slack, desc: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyDescs.slack'), color: 'bg-[var(--color-accent)]', connected: true }, { name: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyNames.dingtalk'), icon: MessageCircle, desc: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyDescs.dingtalk'), color: 'bg-info-600', connected: false }, { name: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyNames.feishu'), icon: Bell, desc: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyDescs.feishu'), color: 'bg-[var(--color-secondary)]', connected: false }, { name: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyNames.wecom'), icon: ExternalLink, desc: t('pages.integrations.thirdPartyDescs.wecom'), color: 'bg-[var(--color-success)]', connected: false }, ].map(service => renderThirdPartyCard(service))}
)}
) }

/**
 * 通知数据归一化工具
 *
 * 后端通知接口存在多套路由（admin / v1 notification_router / v2），
 * 返回字段不一致（如 status vs is_read、title vs subject、content vs body）。
 * 此工具把后端原始通知项统一映射为前端组件可用的稳定结构，
 * 避免「有真实通知却显示无标题/无内容」的契约错位问题。
 */

import type { Notification } from '@/types'

export interface NormalizedNotification extends Notification {
  // ── 通知下拉面板（NotificationCenter）使用的 snake_case 别名字段 ──
  subject: string
  body: string
  is_read: boolean
  created_at: string
  channel: string
  link: string | null
  metadata: Record<string, any>
}

export interface NotificationListData {
  items: NormalizedNotification[]
  total: number
  unread_count: number
  page: number
  page_size: number
  total_pages: number
}

/**
 * 归一化单条通知。
 * 兼容以下后端响应形态：
 * - admin:  { id, type, status, title, content, link, metadata, read_at, created_at }
 * - v1:     { id, type, title, content, metadata, is_read, read_at, created_at }
 * - v2:     { id, type, title, content, link, metadata, is_read, created_at }
 */
export function normalizeNotification(raw: any): NormalizedNotification {
  const isRead = raw?.is_read ?? (raw?.status ? raw.status === 'read' : false)
  const createdAt = raw?.created_at ?? raw?.createdAt ?? ''
  const readAt = raw?.read_at ?? raw?.readAt ?? null
  const link = raw?.link ?? raw?.actionUrl ?? null
  const metadata = raw?.metadata ?? raw?.data ?? {}

  return {
    id: Number(raw?.id),
    type: (raw?.type || 'system') as Notification['type'],
    title: raw?.title || '',
    message: raw?.content || raw?.message || '',
    userId: Number(raw?.userId ?? raw?.user_id ?? 0),
    isRead,
    readAt: readAt ?? undefined,
    createdAt,
    actionUrl: link ?? undefined,
    data: metadata,
    metadata,

    subject: raw?.title || '',
    body: raw?.content || raw?.message || '',
    is_read: isRead,
    created_at: createdAt,
    channel: raw?.channel || 'in_app',
    link,
  }
}

/**
 * 归一化通知列表响应。
 * 兼容：
 * - admin: { items, total, unread_count, page, page_size }
 * - v2:    { items, pagination: { page, page_size, total, total_pages }, unread_count }
 */
export function normalizeNotificationList(raw: any): NotificationListData {
  const items = Array.isArray(raw?.items)
    ? raw.items.map(normalizeNotification)
    : []

  const total = raw?.total ?? raw?.pagination?.total ?? items.length
  const page = raw?.page ?? raw?.pagination?.page ?? 1
  const page_size = raw?.page_size ?? raw?.pagination?.page_size ?? 20
  const rawTotalPages = raw?.pagination?.total_pages
  const totalPages = rawTotalPages
    ?? (page_size > 0 ? Math.ceil(total / page_size) : 1)

  return {
    items,
    total,
    unread_count: raw?.unread_count ?? 0,
    page,
    page_size,
    total_pages: Math.max(1, totalPages),
  }
}
